When writing unit tests for package validators, explicitly assert that all expected checks are present, pass, and are emitted in strict byte-order by ID, as required by the general rules.

```javascript
    expect(result.validatorResult.summary.validation_status).toBe('pass');
    expect(result.validatorResult.checks.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([
      'accepted_receipts_replay_validated',
      'blockers_have_explicit_terminal_reasons',
      'checks_sorted_by_id',
      'every_visual_required_row_has_receipt_or_blocker',
      'expected_visual_required_count',
      'merged_rows_match_visual_required_inventory',
      'no_external_vlm_calls',
      'no_input_diagnostics',
      'readback_counts_present',
      'receipts_and_blockers_do_not_grant_student_display_or_rights',
      'receipts_have_required_replay_fields',
      'schema_version',
      'vlm_metadata_separate_from_deterministic_authority',
    ]);
    expect(result.validatorResult.checks.every((c) => c.status === 'pass')).toBe(true);
```

Fixed in d5f2c0cdd: the full production unit test now asserts the exact 13 validator check IDs in emitted order and verifies every check status is pass.

Fixed in d5f2c0cdd: full-858 production ordering now uses UTF-8 byte-order comparison for receipts, blockers, row refs, inventory refs, coverage lists, and count keys; the full manifest was regenerated. The Wave 1 artifact check remains byte-stable.
Fixed in d5f2c0cdd: removed checksAreSortedById and simplified withSortedChecksOrderingCheck to append checks_sorted_by_id and return sortChecksById(checksWithOrderingCheck).
Fixed in d5f2c0cdd: added a missing-required-input fail-closed test that asserts input_file_missing diagnostics, failed validation, empty receipt/blocker/row outputs, and zero accepted receipt count.
